video_title: LeBron to Warriors if Lakers Resign Austin Reaves?!?

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young's leverage in potential trade discussions with the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: it feels like a little bit of leverage play for me that Trae wants to make sure
quotes.quote: It feels like a little bit of leverage play for me that Trae wants to make sure the Wizards take care of him. When he went that direction, it felt like there was already a handshake deal in place, especially when it seemed like he was healthy enough to play and then he wasn't playing. It added fuel to the fire where you guys know this stuff happens all the time. We need to drop some games this year, get the number one pick, but here is what we got for you on the back end. So I am a little bit surprised that there is as much noise around Trae as there is.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's push for a move to Washington or Memphis
quotes.excerpt: Darryn is trying to push his way to either Washington or Memphis
quotes.quote: The optics in Utah have been tricky because you have the Ace thing last year, you have the Darryn Peterson thing this year, and in free agency you have Walker Kessler being frustrated. So there is that narrative of players, do they want to be in Utah? Now with Darryn, he is trying to push his way to either Washington or Memphis. It didn't work for Ace, and that is the Jazz's counter. We have literally seen this movie a year ago and guess what, Ace is an important part of our program and that bluff was called.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Predictions for the top three picks in the upcoming NBA draft
quotes.excerpt: I got DeBonza first. I am going to go with Peterson and say they do the Bailey thing
quotes.quote: I got DeBonza first. I am going to go with Peterson and say they do the Bailey thing and just push right through it. And Memphis has been tied to Boozer for a long time. The one thing as a subplot that I did love, and I don't know if I am reading the room the right way, but when it comes to the Jazz, you had a funny couple days of news where it was like, Peterson doesn't want to work out, that makes the Jazz look bad. Then I wrote the Walker Kessler thing, he is frustrated. Then the story you mentioned, Chandler, what I loved about it in terms of the chessboard and the way the media comes into play is the Jazz immediately getting it out there that they are seriously considering Cam Boozer.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Likelihood of LeBron James and Austin Reaves returning to the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I think if Austin gets paid in the kind of way that keeps him in town
quotes.quote: I think if Austin gets paid in the kind of way that keeps him in town, then there is not enough money for LeBron to feel respected and then I could see him going up the coast and maybe doing the Warriors thing. I feel like there is just not enough money to make all those guys happy with the Lakers. All of their guys are signaling, I will stay if you don't disrespect me with the number. That is basically what the shared messaging is. If Austin gets paid in the kind of way that keeps him in town, then there is not enough money for LeBron to feel respected.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's potential future with the Pelicans or Kings
quotes.excerpt: The only two teams I have heard and I will pick one of them is New Orleans
quotes.quote: The only two teams I have heard and I will pick one of them is New Orleans and Sacramento. I will probably push it the New Orleans way.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer's reluctance to trade Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Steve Ballmer who as we know runs that whole kingdom is still acting like he doesn't want
quotes.quote: Clippers. It doesn't make a lot of sense contractually, but Steve Ballmer who as we know runs that whole kingdom is still acting like he doesn't want to give Kawhi up.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle's future with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I think they are going to continue swinging and missing on big names
quotes.quote: I don't personally think the Timberwolves have a pathway to, I hate to say it, I think they are going to continue swinging and missing on big names. So I think Julius stays put.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr.'s future with the Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: He should go back to Denver to try to write that wrong
quotes.quote: He should go back to Denver to try to write that wrong. They, MPJ, he had a hell of a year.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pistons' need to make aggressive roster moves
quotes.excerpt: Detroit is going to be loud. I think they know they got to make a move
quotes.quote: Detroit is going to be loud. I think they know they got to make a move because they have been tied to Austin Reaves, they have been tied to a bunch of different guys. They just know that they need some more juice on that roster. So let's do MPJ to Detroit.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's future with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I am keeping him there. It is not the name does not match the game anymore
quotes.quote: I am keeping him there. It is not the name does not match the game anymore in terms of the market and if you tie it to the contract. I don't think the market for AD, given who he is and what he is accomplished, I don't see teams giving up too much for him at this point. So I think he has got to make it work in DC.
